Modern.tagline: The only word that gets you to the gym.

Modern.manifesto: Most gyms market on transformation — the body, the year, the program. The rest takes care of itself.

Creative.industrySummary: Fitness brands sell two things right now. Calm. Or guilt. Neither is fun. There is room for one that treats fitness like a project you're excited about, not a debt you're paying.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Barry's (barrysbootcamp.com) is the loud one. Solidcore (solidcore.co) is the disciplined one. The cult-fitness brands of Brooklyn (Mark Fisher Fitness, Tier Four) are the closest in voice. We're more direct, less inside-joke.

Creative.brandNameRationale: Two words that are slightly rude and slightly right. Sweat More is the only instruction the studio gives. It refuses to argue methodology, format, or programming. It just names the outcome.
Creative.manifesto: Fitness brands have become methodology cults. Pilates is the answer. HIIT is the answer. Strength is the answer. We made Sweat More because the only honest answer is the obvious one — you are not sweating enough. Pick anything. Show up. Sweat. The methodology is downstream of the effort.
Creative.industrySummary: Studios compete on methodology. The customer is methodology-fatigued. There is a real opening for a brand that takes a step back, names the outcome, and lets the customer pick from a rotating menu of disciplines.
Creative.competitorLandscape: ClassPass (classpass.com) plays the multi-discipline aggregator role. Equinox (equinox.com) holds the premium multi-format position. Barry's (barrys.com) is the format-purist peer. We sit between aggregation and format with a single, opinionated message.

typography.rationale: Two faces, two volumes. The brand is loud where it matters and quiet everywhere else.

Creative.brandDescription: Sweat More is a studio that rotates disciplines weekly — and refuses to argue which one is best.
Creative.mission: Members come for the effort, not the method. The schedule rotates. The marketing is the effort itself.
Creative.vision: The methodology is downstream of the effort.
coreValues: Loud — a core principle the brand operates by.
Opinionated — a clear point of view is the point.
Warm — we are friendly, not formal.
Direct — we say what we mean without softening it.
Creative.scope:
SWEAT MORE works across:
• Rotating week
• The shirt
• Effort, not numbers
